skill.name: douyin-video-copy-extract
skill.description: 用于抖音文案提取、抖音文案一键提取、抖音视频文案提取、抖音视频转文字、抖音口播转文字和抖音逐字稿。用户粘贴抖音视频链接、分享文案或 aweme_id 后，提取视频上下文、原视频简介和口播逐字稿。
skill.summary: Extract Douyin video descriptions, spoken transcripts, and reusable text through SocialDataX.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts match Markdown, readable Chinese prose, or a credential check that reports only presence. The CLI examples execute an unpinned npm package with access to the agent environment. Polling lacks a time or attempt limit; no evidence found of credential exfiltration, encoded payloads, or audit-directed prompt injection.

remediation.issue: SKILL.md:75-76 requires continued polling without a maximum duration or attempt count.
remediation.suggestion: Add elapsed-time and attempt limits, bounded backoff, and a resumable job status response when either limit is reached.

content.user_title: Extract Douyin Video Transcripts and Copy
content.value_statement: Turning Douyin speech into reusable text can require manual transcription. This skill guides SocialDataX extraction of video descriptions, transcripts, concise summaries, and optional subtitles.
actual_capabilities: Submit Douyin transcription using a video URL, share text, or aweme_id.
Resume an existing transcription job through its job_id without submitting the video again.
Use the documented SocialDataX CLI or three corresponding hosted MCP tools.
Organize returned video information, original descriptions, spoken transcripts, reusable copy, and concise summaries.
Export SRT through CLI 0.2.64 or newer when valid timing segments exist and the requested destination is new.
Report terminal errors and distinguish retryable failures from failures that should not be resubmitted.
limitations: Requires SocialDataX access and sufficient service balance; direct CLI calls require a readable API key.
Supports Douyin extraction only and provides no account login, posting, liking, or commenting workflow.
SRT export requires direct CLI execution and valid returned timing segments; hosted MCP alone does not save a local file.
The supplied files contain instructions, not the external CLI implementation; dependency behavior and transcription accuracy were not independently verified.

use_cases.title: Prepare Reusable Video Copy
use_cases.description: Extract your video description and spoken transcript, then organize reusable text without adding unsupported claims.

use_cases.title: Review Interview Material
use_cases.description: Collect returned video context and a transcript from an authorized Douyin source for manual review.

use_cases.title: Prepare Subtitle Files
use_cases.description: Export timed SRT subtitles to a new local file when the completed job includes valid timing segments.

prompt_templates.title: Extract a Video Transcript
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the description and spoken transcript from this Douyin video: [video URL]. Mark missing information as unavailable.

prompt_templates.title: Organize Shared Video Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this Douyin share text: [share text]. Return the original description, transcript, reusable copy, and a concise summary after successful completion.

prompt_templates.title: Resume an Existing Job
prompt_templates.prompt: Query Douyin transcription job [job_id] without resubmitting it. Respect polling delays and stop after five queries, returning its status if unfinished.

prompt_templates.title: Export Subtitles from a Completed Job
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the direct CLI to query Douyin job [job_id] and export subtitles to [new SRT path]. Check version, destination, and timing segments first.

output_examples.input: Illustrative completed result: organize a video whose returned description and transcript explain camera placement.
output: Video information: title, author, publication time, and duration were not returned.
Original description: A simple camera placement tip.
Spoken transcript: Place the camera at eye level. Check the framing before recording.
Reusable copy: Place the camera at eye level and check the framing before recording.
Concise summary: Check camera height and framing before recording.

output_examples.input: Illustrative interrupted session: the existing transcription job is still processing and further tool calls are unavailable.
output: Job identifier: Retain the identifier returned by the service.
Next step: Query the same job when tool access resumes. Do not submit the video again.

best_practices: Configure credentials through supported secret storage and check only whether they are readable, never their values.
Review and pin the CLI package before execution; preserve the same job identifier and set a polling budget.
Check returned facts and timing segments before delivery; save subtitles only to a confirmed new destination.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into conversations, logs, screenshots, or committed configuration files.
Do not repeatedly submit the same video while an existing job is processing or the account lacks balance.
Do not invent transcript text, video metadata, or subtitle timestamps when the service does not return them.

faq.question: Which inputs are supported?
faq.answer: Use a Douyin video URL, share text, or aweme_id for submission. Use an existing job_id to continue a task.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: Direct CLI execution requires a SocialDataX API key in its execution environment. An authenticated hosted MCP connection does not require local CLI credentials.

faq.question: Does this skill operate my Douyin account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow does not log in, post, like, comment, or change account settings.

faq.question: Can it create SRT subtitles?
faq.answer: Yes, through CLI 0.2.64 or newer when valid timing segments exist. The output directory must be writable, and the target must not exist.

faq.question: What happens if transcription is unfinished?
faq.answer: Query the same job identifier after the suggested delay. Set a time or attempt limit, then retain the identifier for later continuation.

faq.question: Is the service free?
faq.answer: The workflow can return insufficient-balance errors and directs users to SocialDataX billing. These files do not specify pricing or guarantee free access.
